identity.fantasy: A mobile elven field captain who cycles magical arrows and horns while falcons, dragonhawks, flowers, and allied attackers turn positioning into shared pressure.
identity.one_line: A falcon and Dragonhawk commander that generates Advantage, cycles magical arrows and Horns, and creates Dream Flowers allies can collect. Command Aura, Frenzy, Thalassian Brand, and Petalkeeper make it valuable support. A recent player describes the spec as demanding because positioning, Horn timing, arrows, pets, and teammate reach all matter.

mechanics.core_loop: Use Quick Shot and Horns to create Falconstrikes and Advantage, spend Advantage on magical arrows such as Emerald Arrow, collect or exploit Dream Flower effects, and choose party buffs or burst support appropriate to the group.
mechanics.single_target: Build Advantage, accelerate its spender through Thread the Needle, and align Falconstrike, Emerald Arrow, Thalassian Brand, or Command Aura with the group's damage window.
mechanics.aoe: Pet and arrow effects contribute cleave, but the strongest documented identity is ranged group support rather than raw pack damage.
mechanics.movement_and_target_switching: Falconstrike and Battle Screech can grant movement speed, but Dream Flowers and teammate reach create positional constraints that do not appear in a target-dummy rotation.
mechanics.defense_and_control: Ranger movement and pet tools aid repositioning; Farstrider primarily prevents pressure by fighting at range and accelerating the group.
mechanics.group_utility: Horn of War, Horn of Alacrity, Command Aura, Frenzy, Thalassian Brand, and Dream Flowers make party amplification the core purpose rather than a side bonus.

append_claims.notes: Useful current play description, not a finished endgame guide.

append_claims.text: An August support discussion reports extremely low current Farstrider log representation and weak apparent results, while also showing uncertainty about whether the cited runs were Mythic 0 or Mythic+.
append_claims.notes: Representation is a signal of evidence scarcity, not proof of spec power.

append_claims.text: Farstrider complexity is coordination-heavy: party reach, cooldown timing, and target lifetime determine the value of its major support buttons.
Recent discussion treats Farstrider primarily as Ranger's team-support option; battleground value, personal damage, and the effect of later unlocks are all disputed.
